newsitem.title: USA: Ralcorp ski, cereal/snack sales cleared.
newsitem.headline: Ralcorp ski, cereal/snack sales cleared.

text.p: Ralcorp Holdings Inc on Friday said the U.S. Department of Justice agreed to allow the company to complete the sale of its ski resort holdings to Vail Resorts Inc.
The agreement requires that Vail Resorts subsequently sell the smallest of the three resorts, Arapahoe Basin in Colorado, Ralcorp said.
In addition, Ralcorp said the U.S. Federal Trade Commission cleared the completion of the $570 million sale of Ralcorp's branded cereal and snack business to General Mills Inc.
The ski operations sale is valued at about $310 million, Ralcorp said. The sale was announced in July.
The branded cereals and snacks deal, announced in early 1996, is expected to be completed on January 31.
Ralcorp is the nation's largest private-label cereal maker.
